summary: The complete local CSR product repeats for every requested iteration; final MPI gathering is additionally included in the measured interval.

source_evidence.claim: Contiguous floor-partitions cover the matrix, and per-call CSR offsets are rebased by rowDelimiters[rowStart]. Every iteration calls the full local kernel without result reuse.

compiled_evidence.claim: vmulsd/vaddsd at 9eeb/9ef3 is inside the entry/row traversal and outer 9f87->9e90 repetition backedge. Gathering follows all repetitions before the stop clock.
